name: @bojackduy/opentui-three-showcase
description: 3D Terminal Arcade — neon 3x3 Three.js showcase rendered inside a terminal via OpenTUI and WebGPU

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --target bun --outfile dist/index.js --external "@opentui/core" --external "@opentui/core-*" --external "@opentui/three" --external three --external bun-webgpu --external jimp
scripts.prepack: bun run typecheck && bun run build
scripts.release:patch: bun run typecheck && bun run build && npm version patch -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:minor: bun run typecheck && bun run build && npm version minor -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
scripts.release:major: bun run typecheck && bun run build && npm version major -m "chore: release %s" && git push && git push origin $(git describe --tags --abbrev=0)
